# Prompt
Use only the supplied CSV. Do not browse, execute code or use tools. Predict whether each anti-TNF antibody is active(1) or inactive(0) for human FcRIIIa V158-dependent NFAT-luc2 Jurkat reporter activation in coculture with membrane-TNF CHO-K1 target cells. Active includes residual reporter activity; inactive means fully inactive. Antibody0.04-250nM,24h. This is an ADCC mechanism-of-action reporter, not a direct NK-cell killing endpoint. The seven antibodies share identical target-binding variable regions and light chains; their mature heavy-chain constant regions differ. The CSV contains full mature heavy and light chains. Return exactly one JSON object mapping every candidate ID to0 or1, without explanations.

The following study information applies to this case:

Same anti-TNF binding site; full antibody heavy/light chain sequences. All targets experimentally tested. Source phenotype decisions use observed activity above background, not an invented EC50 threshold. The targets come from related but distinct effector mechanisms; tasks must run in independent contexts.
